payload.text: build runs xcodegen only when project.yml or the set of sources changed and xcodebuild Debug or --release under native/macos/Menuz as the siblings do; test runs the MenuzTests target; install builds Release and puts the app at opt/menuz/Menuz.app of the tree it runs from, quits every running copy, registers the bundle and launches it with an empty environment; use dev|opt records which build the shim's launch and status use, after devbin's own switch (D6); uninstall, start, stop, restart and stamps as designed; each refuses by name, exit 2, without xcodegen or xcodebuild, and install refuses when native/macos/Menuz is absent.
